design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (special_order_servicing, category special).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 6, 4]}. Assignment: storage fee 6, delay credit 6, deposit-program damage allowance 4, deposit-program delivery charge 4 (multiset matches).
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: special_ext_prepaid_delivery_charge / bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4 and special_ext_prepaid_damage_allowance / accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664, both restricted to deposit_pct 100 programs. Claimed here (deposit_pct 50 programs only, so no overlap of domain): special_ext_deposit_damage_allowance (post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89, agent, state_due), special_ext_deposit_delivery_charge (bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad, agent, state_due), special_ext_storage_fee (bill_storage_fee_4a2244a6, agent, state_due), special_ext_delay_credit (accept_delay_credit_eaface8f, user, on_request). After this task every extended policy is claimed exactly once; no headroom is left unused or reserved.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: Gwendolyn keeps cabinets the vendor delivered 38 days late and asks for the late-delivery credit. Core scored parameter: credit_amount 137.39. Hidden prerequisites (fan-out of three): the delay credit rule waits on (1) every damage allowance owed standing as a credit - her handover damage claim already chose an allowance but none is booked; (2) the home delivery charge for a delivered order standing as a fee line - none was billed at release; (3) for a released order, the storage charge for days held past the free hold - none was billed though the item sat 48 days. Allowance and delivery charge feed the credit base (value_input); storage is a state gate. Breadth: special order ledger and request, installation contract and its ledger, consumer card account and its purchases.
[Problem-tree card] Root special_ext_delay_credit (user). Edge A: -> special_ext_deposit_damage_allowance, value_input, gate allowances, form state, sentence 'The delay credit is not worked out until every damage allowance owed for a damage claim registered on the order stands as a credit on it.' (negated direction; state = damage_allowance credit lines; the only write of the difficulty that books one for a deposit-program order is post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89). Unmet: special_requests row remedy_choice damage_allowance, status submitted, no special_credit_applied line among the five ledger lines. Edge B: -> special_ext_deposit_delivery_charge, value_input, gate delivery_fees, form state, sentence 'Before the delay credit is fixed, the home delivery charge owed for a delivered order must stand on the order as a fee line.' (affirmative 'before'); only bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad books a home_delivery_fee line on a deposit-program order. Unmet: fulfillment home_delivery, completed 2026-09-30, no fee line. Edge C: -> special_ext_storage_fee, state_gate, gate special_order_events.fee_type, form state, sentence 'A delay credit on an order the store has released is booked only after the storage charge owed for the days held past the free hold period stands on the order.' (affirmative 'only after'); only bill_storage_fee_4a2244a6 books a storage_fee line. Unmet: ready 2026-08-13, left the store 2026-09-30, no storage line. Directions differ by sentence (negated / before / only after). Topological order: allowance (10), delivery (12), storage (14) in any order, then credit (16). Six-order permutation replay: identical terminal hash. Deletion sensitivity (run): skip allowance -> 197.66; skip delivery -> 134.54; skip storage -> 137.39 but the storage line is missing (terminal differs).
[Base-invariant card] Credits (subject special_credit_applied, steps 10 and 16): special_receipt_and_damage.reported_in_time is the only gate on that subject - completed_date 2026-09-30, damage_report_hours 72 for Semi-Custom Cabinetry, full hours from 00:00, inclusive; claim registered 2026-09-30 15:20 (15 hours); 2026-10-03 00:00 qualifies, 00:01 does not. special_vendor_delay (policy scope): delay 38 > 21, already shipped -> only the delay credit, posted once, none on the ledger. special_cancellation, special_returns, special_price_protection: policy scope (not cancelled, not returnable, price_protection_days 0). Fees (subject special_fee_charged, steps 12 and 14): special_agg_install_link (not linked), special_cancellation, special_pickup_storage_abandonment (held 48 days then delivered, not abandoned), special_delivery (home delivery offered), special_returns - all policy scope.
[Overwrite] special_vendor_delay 'receive a delay credit of delay_credit_pct percent of the order total, capped at delay_credit_max_usd, posted once as credit_type delay_credit' -> 'On a deposit-program order the delay credit is worked out by the rules below rather than as delay_credit_pct percent of the order total.' (base 243.00, this policy 137.39). special_receipt_and_damage allowance clause -> 'For a deposit-program order the allowance is set by the rules below in place of that plain percentage.' (base 729.00, this 1,015.90). special_delivery charge clause -> 'On a deposit-program order the delivery charge is set by the rules below, which take the place of the flat program charge.' (base 149.00, this 81.33). special_pickup_storage_abandonment hold clause -> 'The storage charge billed when the item leaves the store is set by the rules below in place of that day count and rate.' (base 180.00, this 34.20).
[Factor card - allowance (4, baseline 729.00)] installation_status_rate (parameter, cross install): contract at address cancelled -> 16 (baseline 15 -> 957.09); report_timing_multiplier: claim registered on completed_date -> 1.1 (-> 930.36); holding_multiplier: 48 days -> 1.1 (-> 930.36); lateness_settlement (method): 38 days -> +75.00 (-> 940.90). Result 1,015.90.
[Factor card - delivery (4, baseline 149.00)] load_value_basis (method): 4,860.00 >= 4,500.00 -> max(149.00, 170.10) = 170.10 (-> 71.24); late_arrival_share 0.75 (-> 108.44); handover_condition_share 0.75 (-> 108.44); cardholder_tenure_share (cross card, one record): active, 87 months -> 0.85 (-> 95.68). Result 81.33.
[Factor card - storage (6, baseline 180.00)] late_arrival_hold +7 (-> 68.40); receipt_delay_hold +4, store receipt 6 days after shipment (-> 57.00); weekly_day_count (method): 7 storage days -> 6 billable (-> 39.90); cardholder_project_share (cross card, multi-source): 2 special-order/installation purchases in 12 months, near-misses 2025-08-14 (13 months) and 2026-07-03 (in_store) excluded -> 0.75 (-> 45.60); order_size_share 0.95 (-> 36.00); quoted_installation_share (cross install, multi-source over contract row + its install_charges): cancelled contract at the address with a 99.00 payment on that contract -> 0.8 (-> 42.75). Result 34.20.
[Factor card - delay credit (6, baseline 196.27)] delay_length_rate 6 (-> 117.77); prompt_claim_bonus 0.5 (-> 127.58); allowance_cut_rate 1, allowance 1,015.90 >= 972.00 (-> 157.01); lost_installation_bonus (cross install, one record) 0.5, cancelled 2026-06-04 <= promised 2026-07-06 (-> 127.58); production_length_bonus 1, 79 days (-> 117.77); own_wait_settlement (method) halves, 48 days (-> 274.78). Result: base 3,925.43 x 7 percent = 274.78 -> 137.39.
[Business-object card] Single order SO-0471-718842 and its single damage claim; the allowance carries the claim id; the delay credit creates its own delay_remedy request. Rows read for evidence: billed line, store receipt line, handover line; the two payment lines enter no figure. Install ledger: measure fee 99.00, its card payment, the measure visit. Card ledger: four purchases, three payments (balance 188.40).
[Seed rows] Removing the claim's remedy choice removes edge A's owed allowance; removing the store receipt line changes the receipt-hold tier; removing the install contract drops three cross-install tiers; removing the 2025-12-05 or 2026-04-28 card purchase drops the cardholder project share to 0.9. Automatic clauses: order completed (no abandonment); the residual credit balance after gold (-1,037.76) arises from the customer's own allowance and credit and no rule of the charter books a refund of it unasked.
[Persona] Gwendolyn: organised, polite; volunteers phone, the late cabinets, keeping them, wanting the late-delivery credit. On request: DOB 1977-11-02 (ZIP 43026 as a further detail), order number, delivery address, the lapsed installation quote, having a Ridgeline card. Passive: confirms the door scuff and her allowance choice only if the agent raises the claim; agrees to charges/credits being put on first; accepts the hand-over at the stated amount; closes. No mention of storage, delivery charges or the allowance.
[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify(phone, DOB) -> find_special_orders -> find_special_order_events -> find_special_requests -> find_install_contracts -> find_install_charges -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> post_damage_allowance(1015.90) -> bill_deposit_delivery(81.33) -> bill_storage_fee(6 days, 34.20) -> accept_delay_credit(137.39) by the customer.
[Gates run] check_task_tools: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (6 tools). check_extended --task 1: EXTENDED OK. check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK (comps 4 fact 20 xfac 5 hist 9 brch 61 step 17). replay_tasks --task 1: REPLAY OK (clos 20 init 20). check_solvability --task 1: SOLVABILITY OK. check_grounding --task 1: GROUNDING OK. check_cross_fire --task 1: SCOPE OK.
[Revisions] symptom: check_task_tools flagged storage_days integer precision -> docstring states integer precision. symptom: check_extended counted a module-level helper function as an undiscoverable task tool -> helper replaced by a defaults dict inlined into each create call; all gates re-run green.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] Reading the delay credit rule: three waits (allowance credit, delivery fee line, storage line on a released order) all unmet in the ledger; their own rules give 1,015.90, 81.33 and 34.20 (6 billed days); the credit rule then gives 137.39 - identical to gold.
[Round 2 rework - audit env/env_0046_home_improvement_retailer/audits/policy_task/special_order_servicing/ (1.md, _difficulty.md)]
G2/T1-1 (installation-rate tiers conjoined 'measured by a Ridgeline installer', true of every deposit-program order because pro_measure_required is true in all three): change - the conjunct is removed; the ladder (renamed installation_status_rate) now partitions on the status of the installation contract at the delivery address alone (scheduled or in_progress -> onsite_rate 10; cancelled -> self_install_rate 16; otherwise damage_allowance_pct), declared single-source; rule, compute.allowance_pct, compute_basis and factor updated together.
G3/T1-2 (custody tiers conjoined 'a store receipt inspection recorded good', true of every handed-over deposit-program order): change - the custody multiplier is replaced by report_timing_multiplier, read from the damage claim's registration day against completed_date (same day 1.1, next day 1.05, otherwise 1; LATEST special_requests.created_at); rule sentence, product sentence, compute (claim_registered, report_gap, report_mult), compute_basis, factor and inputs.history updated. On this world the claim was registered on completed_date, so the value 1.1 and the allowance 1,015.90 are unchanged.
G4/T1-3 (storage quoted-installation share summed install payments over all contracts while the rule names the contract at the delivery address): change - compute now locates that contract (quote_contract = CFIELD install_contract_id at the delivery address) and sums install_payment_received only with install_contract_id = quote_contract; the ladder text says 'on that contract'. On the constructed G4 situation the two faces now agree (0.9). This world: still 0.8, storage 34.20.
G11 (storage_days 6 vs 7): the storage rule now states 'The storage fee line records the billable days as its days of storage billed.', and the tracing cites it; 6 is the only reading.
G9: the allowance edge's effect no longer asserts the upper tier ('moves the allowance cut off its zero tier'). G8: deposit delivery docstring reworded ('with the balance due at release'). G14 realism (quoted_installation_share, lost_installation_bonus) and the persona's factual cue toward storage: recorded as observations by the audit; kept. Multi-source mislabels in factor_trace corrected: the genuine multi-source factors of this task are cardholder_project_share and quoted_installation_share.
Re-run: all four values unchanged (1,015.90 / 81.33 / 34.20 with 6 days / 137.39); sensitivities unchanged in value (report_timing_multiplier 930.36 replaces custody_multiplier 930.36).
user_scenario: You are Gwendolyn Achterberg-Osei, a homeowner in Hilliard who is redoing her own kitchen, calling Ridgeline Customer Care on a weekday afternoon. You are organised and polite, a retired school librarian, and you keep your paperwork in a folder, though you let the agent do the looking up. Your special-order kitchen cabinets were promised for early July, the store only called in mid-August to say they had arrived, and Ridgeline finally delivered them to your house at the end of September. Your neighbour told you that when a vendor runs that late on a special order you can get a credit, and that is why you are calling: you are keeping the cabinets, you are not cancelling anything, and you would like the late-delivery credit put on your order. You start by giving your phone number, 6145550568, and saying what you want. If the agent asks for something more to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1977-11-02; if a further detail is asked for, your billing ZIP code is 43026. If asked for the order number, you read it from your folder: SO-0471-718842; the delivery address is 2280 Brookhollow Ln, Hilliard, OH 43026. If asked, you say you let Ridgeline's installation quote lapse back in June and hired your own carpenter, and that you have a Ridgeline credit card, but you do not know any account figures. If the agent brings up the damage claim from the delivery day, you confirm that one door had a scuff and that you told the delivery crew you would keep the cabinets with an allowance. If the agent explains that other charges or credits have to be put on the order before the delay credit can be worked out, you say that is fine and they should go ahead, since you want the order squared away properly. You have no figure in mind for the credit and you do not suggest one. When the agent tells you the credit amount and hands you the step to accept the delay credit yourself, you accept it at that amount. Once the agent confirms the delay credit is on your order, you thank them and say goodbye; you have nothing else to ask.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.storage_days: Value 6. Basis: the docstring 'the number of storage days billed on the line', and the storage rule 'The storage fee line records the billable days as its days of storage billed.' The 7 storage days (48 days ready to delivery less a 41-day free hold: 30 + 7 late-arrival + 4 receipt) are billed by the weekly count for stays of at least 7 and fewer than 21 days: 6 per full week + 0 remaining = 6 billable days. The unconverted 7 is the storage-day count before billing and is not what the line records.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.storage_fee: Value 34.20. 6 billable days x 10.00 x 0.75 (card active with 2 special-order/installation purchases in 12 months) x 0.95 (billed 4,860.00 between 2x and 4x the order minimum) x 0.8 (cancelled contract at the address with a 99.00 payment) = 34.20, under the 300.00 cap.
